card.name: Decimal point inside numbers
card.fires_on: The decimal point between digits in numbers like 1.5, 2.5, 3.0 and 1.3, mostly right after a single digit. Seen in drug-label text such as MRI field strengths, section numbers, percentages and lab limits.

modes.label: Field strength and strengths
modes.description: Decimal point in values like 1.5 T or 3.0 T or a product strength percentage.
modes.example: Static magnetic field of 3<<.>>0 T or 1.5 T

modes.label: Thresholds and doses
modes.description: Decimal point in multiples of normal limits, grades or doses.

modes.label: Section references
modes.description: Decimal point in numbered label section cross-references.

card.plain: It fires on the decimal point in a number such as 1.5 or 2.5, just before the digit after it.
